text: なんだい　また　やるき　かい？

structure.jp: また　やるき　かい？
structure.en: you mean to go at it again?

patterns.name: 〜かい
patterns.explanation: かい is a casual, mostly male way to end a yes-or-no question. やるき　かい = 'do you mean to fight?'.

patterns.name: 〜だい
patterns.explanation: だい is a casual, mostly male way to end a question that has a question word in it. なんだい = 'what is it?'.
